title: The inbox follows the active location, customer and asset notes show in all
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • Two locations you can switch between: location A, and location B (any other location, for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310).
  • At location A: a notification from a work-order/part-sale note, and a notification from a note on a customer or an asset (which has no location), both written by a second user and tagging you.
custom_steps:
1. At location A, open the inbox and confirm the work-order/part-sale notification and the customer/asset notification are listed and counted.
  2. Switch to location B and re-read the inbox and the bell.
  3. Confirm the other location's work-order notification is not listed at B, but the customer/asset one still is.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The inbox lists, and the bell counts, notifications from work-order, work-order-line and part-sale notes belonging to the active location, plus notifications from customer or asset notes whichever location is active.
  • Switching the active location changes what the inbox lists and the bell counts to that location's notifications.
  • The inbox is never organization-wide: a notification from a note at another location is neither listed nor counted until you switch to that location; but a customer/asset note (no location) is never hidden by switching.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10244 (S1, Work the Notifications inbox); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S1; design boards InboxAfter/Main; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R18: “The inbox lists, and the bell counts, notifications from notes on work orders, work order lines and part sales that belong to the active location, and notifications from notes on a customer or an asset, whichever location is active.”
  • S1-R19: “Switching the active location changes what the inbox lists and what the bell counts to that location's notifications.”
  • S1-N7: “The inbox is never organization-wide. A notification from a note at another location is neither listed nor counted until the user switches to that location.”
  • S1-N8: “A notification from a note on a customer or an asset is never hidden by switching location. Those notes have no location, so they are listed and counted at every location.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
